subject: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Suresh Rao <suresh@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

Suresh — thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Per our call I pulled together the specific items Redwood recommends we jointly validate before the private deployment handoff. Goal: make the first rollout repeatable, auditable, and resilient without adding customer-side footguns.

Top-level asks (we'll go through each in the clinic):
- Confirm egress model choice (central NAT vs. per-az NAT gateway) and cost/availability tradeoffs.
- Establish artifact provenance and signing for images/helm charts.
- Gate terraform modules with policy tests (policy-as-code) and convergent plan checks in CI.
- Harden Ansible roles to not embed secrets; use ephemeral credentials & KMS.
- Define canary promotion workflow (helm values + image tag immutability).

I've attached: priv-iac-egress-topology.svg (diagram), ci-gating-proposal.md (pipeline snippets), ansible-role-matrix.csv (role ownership + tests).

Proposed clinic time: Mon Nov 8 10:00-11:00 PT — a 60-minute working session with whiteboard. Can Vanessa and Naomi join to walk through the CI examples?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Suresh Rao <suresh@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: CloudOps Consulting <ops@cloudops.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

Karthik — thanks, this looks great. We're keen to lock down the egress model: our security team prefers a centralized firewall + NAT appliance for auditing, but our network folks are worried about a single egress choke point.

A few constraints on our side:
- We must route all outbound traffic through the corporate proxy for content filtering (no bypass).
- Approved third-party registries: only our internal registry and RedHat/Quay mirrors.
- Airgap readiness: we may need to run with an image cache behind an appliance during initial rollout.

Mon 10:00 PT works. I'll invite our netsec lead (Raj) and the procurement rep who handles appliance leasing.

Suresh
Acme Corp — Platform Engineering
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, Suresh Rao <suresh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

Team — quick notes before the clinic so we can focus on decisioning:
1) Egress patterns: propose a default per-subnet NAT with optional centralized inspection. Pros: lower blast radius for misconfig, faster failover; Cons: more NAT footprint/cost. We should include a cost delta example per-100k egress MB in the doc.
2) Terraform modules: recommend we require two checks in CI: (a) plan sanity step that compares drift against a golden sample, (b) policy checks (OPA/Rego) running on plan JSON. Block merges on violations.
3) Helm charts: we must pin image digests for canary releases and put a pipeline job to verify chart provenance (integrity + cosign).
4) Ansible: role matrix indicates which roles can run in read-only mode for pre-validation. Add role-level unit tests (molecule).

Attachment: ci-gating-proposal.md contains example GitLab CI jobs and presubmit hook snippets.

Vanessa
Director, Deployment Experience
Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Cc: Suresh Rao <suresh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

Thanks for the invite — brief notes from netsec before the clinic:
- Central inspection appliance is acceptable if HA is demonstrated (active-active) and we have documented failover procedures.
- Any outbound TLS interception must be done with a signed cert chain and documented key custody.
- Request a preflight test that simulates large-scale egress to ensure NAT scaling under surge.

I'll bring the appliance spec and our compliance checklist.

— Raj (NetSec, ACME)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>
Cc: Suresh Rao <suresh@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

I've sketched a CI validation plan we'll demo in the clinic:
- PR presubmit: terraform fmt + validate, helm lint + schema check, ansible-lint.
- Plan gating: run terraform plan -> plan.json -> opa eval (deny on network wide open, public ip creation, security_group_any_any).
- Artifact verification: job that pulls image by digest from acme registry, verifies cosign signature, and copies to deployment registry with provenance metadata.
- Integration test stage: spin up ephemeral namespace (k3s) with limited egress to run smoke and egress throughput tests.

I'll attach a sample GitLab job (we can adapt to Jenkins) and the molecule scenario for ansible.

Naomi
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>

Subject: RE: PrivDeploy CI clinic: egress topology & IaC hygiene

Thanks everyone — good set of constraints and a clear agenda for the clinic. Quick summary of action items before we join:
- ACME: share appliance HA spec and list of allowed registries (Suresh/Raj).
- Redwood (Naomi): prepare the GitLab/Jenkins job snippets and the ephemeral namespace smoke test.
- Redwood (Vanessa): cost delta for per-subnet vs centralized NAT and a recommended fallback plan for appliance failure.
- Redwood (Irene): draft minimal acceptance criteria for policy checks to present as MR gating rules (Rego snippets).
- All: review ci-gating-proposal.md and ansible-role-matrix.csv; annotate inline on the shared doc by EOD Friday.

I'll run the whiteboard and capture decisions; meeting invite updated with Zoom + shared GDrive link.

See you Mon 10:00 PT.

Karthik
